etymology.historical_story: Malaysian reporting attests Remy as a personal name, notably in Remy Ishak. That establishes a naming context, but does not establish the origin or intended meaning of this lowercase corpus item. Without its source sentence or a verified dictionary definition, assigning a French derivation, a card game meaning or Malay affixes would go beyond the available evidence.
